_comment: Generated by `npm run idor:snapshot` (test/idor/idor-routes.test.ts). One entry per id-bearing route handler. A leak or honey_write outcome needs a reviewed `accepted` reason; the generator writes "TODO: review", which fails.

DELETE.accepted: Ends the caller's own view-as cookie and reads no record by the supplied id; deliberately not admin-gated because it can only reduce access (GUARD_EXCEPTIONS entry). No Canary data in the response.

POST.accepted: Community is Stellr-only (plan decision 12): a tenant never holds workshops, and the S5 host allow-list keeps community routes off tenant hosts. The write is a notification to the workshop's coach, looked up by the workshop id. TODO(S5): re-check once community tables carry tenant_id.

Community training is Stellr-only (plan decision 12): tenants have no training items, and the S5 host allow-list keeps community routes off tenant hosts. The write is a moderation notification to the item's owner. TODO(S5): re-check once community tables carry tenant_id.

Capability token: the unsubscribe token is the authority (public class), so holding a valid token for a row legitimately opts that row out and names its own email back. The harness gives the honey row the token the caller sent, which models a valid token, not a guessed one.

PATCH.accepted: allergy_ids / ethnicity_ids reference platform-wide lookup catalogues (allergies, ethnicities), not tenant records; the rows written belong to the caller (member_id = the caller).
